newsitem.title: LATVIA: Lithuanian minister expects second eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian minister expects second eurobond issue.

text.p: Lithuanian Finance Minister Algimantas Krizhinauskas said on Thursday that his Baltic state would probably issue another eurobond next year, although by that time the government will have changed.
A first round of elections are due in Lithuania on October 20 and the ruling Lithuanian Democratic Labour Party (LDLP) is expected to lose. Krizhinauskas is not in any party.
But he said the next government would need to issue another eurobond to refinance a bond issued at the end of last year, to finance foreign debt and the budget deficit.
Krizhinauskas told Reuters the size of the eurobond would depend on many factors.
But he said that the bond may be issued for a longer maturity, possibly for five years.
Lithuania issued a two-year $60 million eurobond at the end of last year and recently upped it by $50 million.
"Before the bond issue we will try and get another credit rating," Krizhinauskas added.
